{{Quote|I'm sure you've gotten the inventory from ''Reckless Abandon'' already, but here's ''my'' copy, just to make sure they're the same. Foodstuffs, ammunition, munitions, spare starfighter parts, several barrels of inadequately aged Tanaab fruit brandies...|Wes Janson, speaking to Wedge Antilles|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Reckless Abandon''''' was a [[Gallofree Yards, Inc./Legends|Gallofree Yards]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] which was escorted to [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Delivering vital supplies for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] garrison stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], ''Reckless Abandon'' was accompanied by the [[Taanab Yellow Aces]]. Although attacked by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] forces as it journeyed towards Borleias, the transport was protected by several New Republic [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and made its way safely to its destination.

==Description==
The ''Reckless Abandon'' was an unknown class of [[Gallofree Yards, Inc./Legends|Gallofree Yards]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]].

==History==
{{Quote|Twin Suns, this is ''Rebel Dream''. Sensors show more skip squadrons incoming, but we think our payload will be out of the minefield and through with its last microjump before they arrive.|''Rebel Dream''{{'s}} communications officer|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand" />}}
Following the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|loss]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], the [[New Republic Third Fleet]] set up a defense on [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] in order to tie down the [[Yuuzhan Vong fleet]] while the [[New Republic Advisory Council|Advisory Council]] recovered from the conquest of its capital. The ''Reckless Abandon'' delivered supplies to Borleias while it held out against the Yuuzhan Vong, delivering much needed goods and support to the embattled garrison. Escorted by New Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] and his [[Taanab Yellow Aces]], the ''Reckless Abandon'' set out for Borleias, loaded with munitions, foodstuffs, ammunition and several barrels of [[Taanab fruit brandy]].

When it came out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in the [[Pyria system]], the ''Reckless Abandon'' and its fighter escorts emerged in a [[dovin basal]] minefield positioned by the Yuuzhan Vong. [[Yorik-et]], Yuuzhan Vong starfighters, converged on the transport, but it was able to be protected by Janson and his squadron. One of the [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] defending Borleias, the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Mon Mothma (Imperial-class)|''Mon Mothma'']], moved to aid the ''Reckless Abandon'' as it performed a series of microjumps towards Borleias. The ''Reckless Abandon'' was then protected by starfighters from another New Republic [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class]] ''[[Rebel Dream]]'', as well as [[Twin Suns Squadron]]. With so many New Republic [[Starship/Legends|starships]] defending it, the transport made its way towards Borleias.

The ''Reckless Abandon'' arrived safely at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], but not before its [[Captain/Legends|captain]] had to intervene on the New Republic military communications channel in order to ask Janson to refrain from his flirting with [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], [[Twin Suns Leader|Twin Suns One]]. The transport later transmitted its inventory to [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], who commanded the Borleias garrison.
